newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk automotive output rises by 14.7 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Turk automotive output rises by 14.7 pct in May.

text.p: Turkey's automotive vehicle output rose to 37,976 units in May, up 14.7 percent from May last year, the automotive industry association (OSD) said.
In the first five months of 1997, automotive production was up 7.6 percent to 144,250 units, the OSD said.
Car output increased to 23,762 units in May, up 7.7 percent from the same month in 1996, while lorry production increased by 58.3 percent to 3,959 units in the same period.
Production of buses rose to 287 units in May, a rise of 22.6 percent. May minibus output increased by 28.1 percent to 1,051 units and tractor output rose by 4.7 percent to 5,368 units.
